summary.name: Outfit Roast
summary.one_liner: An AI tool that takes a full-body outfit photo, then gives a joking roast, a style score, and suggestions on what to change.
keywords: what to wear on a date
use_cases: Checking a date outfit before going out
Getting honest style feedback on an everyday look
Sharing a funny outfit score with friends
Finding one or two changes to improve a look
Rating an outfit for a specific occasion
summary.what_it_does: The tool accepts one full-body mirror selfie (PNG, JPG or WEBP, max 5MB) and returns a score and a humorous roast of the outfit. Each roast comes with AI style suggestions for what to change. Results are shown as a shareable score and roast card. Users can sign up to get 2 free roasts, and the page says history is kept for 30 days on the free tier. Paid credit packs are offered for more roasts.
notable: Full-body outfit photo upload with score and roast card
Shareable score cards for group chats
Credit packs for additional roasts, with AI style suggestions per roast
caveats: Only 2 free roasts on signup; more require purchasing credits
The $2.99 credit price is a beta tester promotion that ends 30 April 2026 (regular price listed as $4.99)
Free history is kept for 30 days; permanent history is a paid-tier feature
